shots.headline: Mute every microphone at once
shots.sub: Press ⌥⌘M in any app, or click the menu bar icon.

callout.title: Mic Mute
callout.label: Each microphone, as it is now
callout.body: Click one to make it the one your Mac uses. An iPhone can't be muted, so it says so.

shots.headline: Tap ⌥⌘M to switch
shots.sub: A card at the top right says Muted or Unmuted, then puts itself away.

callout.title: Mic Mute
callout.label: It stays muted
callout.body: A microphone you plug in while muted is muted the moment it arrives.

shots.headline: Hold ⌥⌘M to talk
shots.sub: Your microphones are on while you hold it, and muted the moment you let go.

callout.title: Mic Mute
callout.label: If your Mac stops hearing the key
callout.body: The card turns red: your microphones are muted again.

shots.headline: Or a glow round the screen
shots.sub: Clicks go through it, and a screen share never shows it.
